content: Chloroquine Phosphate, USP, is a 4-aminoquinoline compound designed for oral administration. It is a white, odorless, crystalline substance with a bitter taste and is highly soluble in water. Chloroquine Phosphate Tablets are classified as antimalarial and amebicidal drugs. Each tablet intended for oral use contains either 250 mg of chloroquine phosphate (equivalent to 150 mg of the base) or 500 mg of chloroquine phosphate (equivalent to 300 mg of the base). The inactive ingredients in the 250 mg formulation include calcium stearate, colloidal silicon dioxide, dibasic calcium phosphate, microcrystalline cellulose, and talc. The inactive ingredients in the 500 mg formulation include colloidal silicon dioxide, corn starch, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyvinylpyrrolidone, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide. The film coating and polishing solution used for the tablets contains D&C Red 27 Aluminum Lake, D&C Yellow 10 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Blue 1 Aluminum Lake, hypromellose, polyethylene glycol, polysorbate 80, and titanium dioxide.
